source_note: Chinese hot-topic candidates are collected from public trend pages; English wording is matched to supplied official English headlines when possible, otherwise suggested neutrally.

topics.chinese_topic: 未来五年医保改革划了哪些重点
topics.official_english: Key priorities identified for next five-year phase of medical insurance reform
topics.why_hot: Health insurance touches every household, and a signpost for the next five years naturally draws broad public attention.
topics.share_angle: Explain the core priorities of the reform and what they might mean for ordinary patients and medical costs.

topics.chinese_topic: 潲水油飞上天 出口订单排到2027年
topics.official_english: Waste cooking oil fuels flights, export orders booked until 2027
topics.why_hot: The image of wasted cooking oil turning into aviation fuel challenges common assumptions and highlights a growing green-energy export story.
topics.share_angle: Break down how used cooking oil becomes sustainable aviation fuel and why China is becoming a major supplier.

topics.chinese_topic: 汤家凤呼吁取消英语主科地位
topics.official_english: Tang Jiafeng calls for removing English as a core subject
topics.why_hot: A prominent education voice reignited a long-running debate over the weight of English in Chinese schools and exam pressure.
topics.share_angle: Present both sides of the debate while explaining how China decides which subjects count as core ones.

topics.chinese_topic: 在孩子们心中播撒真善美的种子
topics.official_english: Planting seeds of truth, goodness and beauty in children's hearts
topics.why_hot: This phrase captures a widely shared official message about moral education for the young and often comes up as schools reopen.
topics.share_angle: Explain how Chinese public discourse frames moral education and why it gains traction at the start of a school term.

topics.chinese_topic: “宇宙最大医院”连续3任院长落马
topics.official_english: Three consecutive directors of a hospital dubbed China's largest under investigation
topics.why_hot: A hospital famous for its huge scale is in the spotlight after its top management became the focus of anti-corruption probes.
topics.share_angle: Contextualize the cases within China's broader anti-corruption campaign in the medical and health sector.

topics.chinese_topic: 江西吉安发生山体滑坡 十余人被埋
topics.official_english: Landslide in Ji'an, Jiangxi leaves more than ten people buried
topics.why_hot: A sudden landslide with buried victims triggers urgent public concern and attention to rescue operations and disaster prevention.
topics.share_angle: Lead with the rescue picture and emphasize verified updates and safety awareness rather than graphic details.

topics.chinese_topic: 手机涨价 最先扛不住的竟是经销商
topics.official_english: Rising smartphone prices pressure distributors first
topics.why_hot: As phone prices climb, online discussions focus on which part of the sales chain feels the pain before consumers do.
topics.share_angle: Explain the distribution chain behind a price increase and how dealer margins absorb cost shocks.

topics.chinese_topic: 超1万册永乐大典副本下落不明
topics.official_english: Over 10,000 volumes of the Yongle Encyclopedia's copies are unaccounted for
topics.why_hot: The disappearance of priceless handwritten encyclopedia volumes touches a nerve over the loss of cultural heritage.
topics.share_angle: Tell the story of the Yongle Encyclopedia, its significance, and the modern effort to recover or digitally preserve its remaining copies.
